description: Fetch a medicine's card. Give the card's address or any one of three codes: the barcode on the pack (Global Trade Item Number, GTIN), the national pack code, or the authorisation number. Returns the signed card with its stamp; or a list of cards where several share the code; or an empty list. Each fetch leaves a signed receipt.

code.description: a card's address, or a pack barcode (GTIN), a national pack code or an authorisation number

name: fetch
